abstract: We study the effect of ambiguity on timing decisions. An agent faces a stopping problem with an uncertain stopping payoff and a stochastic time limit. The agent is unsure about the correct model quantifying the uncertainty and seeks to maximize her payoff guarantee over a set of plausible models. As time passes and the agent updates, the worst-case model used to evaluate a given strategy can change, creating a problem of dynamic inconsistency. We characterize the stopping behavior in this environment and show that, while the agent's myopic incentives are fragile to small changes in the set of considered models, the best consistent plan from which no future self has incentives to deviate is robust.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了模糊性对时机决策的影响。代理人面临一个具有不确定终止收益和随机时间限制的停止问题。代理人不确定量化不确定性的正确模型，并试图在一组合理模型中最大化其收益保障。随着时间推移和代理人更新信息，用于评估给定策略的最坏情况模型可能发生变化，从而产生动态不一致性问题。我们刻画了这种环境下的停止行为，并表明：尽管代理人的短视激励对考虑模型集的微小变化较为脆弱，但未来自我没有动机偏离的最佳一致计划具有稳健性。
title: Timing decisions under model uncertainty
title_zh: 模型不确定性下的时机决策

abstract: This paper investigates a unique policy designed to maintain employment during the privatization of East German firms after the fall of the Iron Curtain. The policy required new owners of the firms to commit to employment targets, with penalties for non-compliance. Using a dynamic model, we highlight three channels through which employment targets impact firms: distorted employment decisions, increased productivity, and higher exit rates. Our empirical analysis, using a novel dataset and instrumental variable approach, confirms these findings. We estimate a 22% points higher annual employment growth rate, a 14% points higher annual productivity growth, and a 3.6% points higher probability of exit for firms with binding employment targets. Our calibrated model further demonstrates that without these targets, aggregate employment would have been 15% lower after 10 years. Additionally, an alternative policy of productivity investment subsidies proved costly and less effective in the short term.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项旨在铁幕倒塌后东德企业私有化过程中维持就业的特殊政策。该政策要求企业新所有者承诺就业目标，并对未达标者实施处罚。通过构建动态模型，我们揭示了就业目标影响企业的三个渠道：扭曲的雇佣决策、生产率提升以及退出率上升。基于新颖数据集与工具变量法的实证分析证实了上述发现。我们估算出，受约束就业目标的企业年就业增长率高出22个百分点，年生产率增长率高出14个百分点，退出概率高出3.6个百分点。校准模型进一步表明，若无此类目标，十年后总就业量将降低15%。此外，替代性的生产率投资补贴政策在短期内成本高昂且效果欠佳。
title: Committing to Grow: Privatizations and Firm Dynamics in East Germany
title_zh: 承诺增长：东德的私有化与企业动态

abstract: This paper examines the impact of transportation infrastructure, designed exclusively to enhance the integration of domestic markets, on a country’s export performance. By leveraging the expansion of China’s high-speed rail (HSR) as a quasi-natural experiment, we provide robust evidence the enhanced within-sector integration that resulted from this infrastructure development significantly boosts firms’ export performance. This impact is observed through increased export sales and volume, expanded market reach, and improved product quality. Our findings are consistent with the notion that HSR connections facilitate knowledge spillovers among exporters, which aids them in overcoming information barriers and thereby improving foreign market access. Importantly, we address potential confounding factors and demonstrate that the findings remain robust when accounting for alternative channels such as supplier and customer access and labor market pooling effects. This study underscores the pivotal role of domestic transportation infrastructure in mitigating information frictions and driving a country’s international market integration.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了专为促进国内市场一体化而设计的交通基础设施对一国出口绩效的影响。通过利用中国高铁（HSR）扩张作为准自然实验，我们提供了有力证据，表明由此类基础设施发展带来的行业内一体化显著提升了企业的出口绩效。这一影响体现在出口销售额与出口量的增长、市场覆盖范围的扩大以及产品质量的提升上。我们的研究结果与以下观点一致：高铁连接促进了出口企业间的知识溢出，帮助其克服信息壁垒，从而改善海外市场准入。重要的是，我们排除了潜在的混淆因素，并证明在考虑供应商与客户可达性以及劳动力市场集聚效应等替代渠道后，研究结论依然稳健。本研究凸显了国内交通基础设施在缓解信息摩擦、推动一国国际市场一体化中的关键作用。

title: Geographic Integration and Firm Exports: Evidence from China
title_zh: 地理整合与企业出口：来自中国的证据
